description.value: Sportsman's Inn is a hotel located in Northern BC along Beattie Drive, tagged in OpenStreetMap as a commercial tourism property. Its name and remote northern location suggest it likely caters to hunters, anglers, and outdoor travellers passing through this sparsely populated region. Touring cyclists riding routes through northeastern BC may find it a practical overnight stop in an area with limited accommodation options.
